Functional Analyst M/V/X
Référence 5869216
|
Créé le 11 juin 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 3 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
Join a Leading Tech Innovator in Data Storage Solutions.
As a Functional Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in our team, focusing on requirements gathering, process modeling, and ensuring the coherence of our solutions. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, translate requirements into functional specifications, and support engineering activities as needed.
Role
Elicit and document business requirements through stakeholder meetings and workshops.
Create detailed functional designs, process models using BPMN, and user stories.
Provide third-line support, troubleshooting incidents post-development, and training end-users.
Contribute to disaster recovery planning and ensure business continuity.
Profil
Profile
Proven experience as a Functional Analyst or similar role.
Expertise in UML, BPMN, and data modeling.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience with API definition, functional testing, and regression testing.
Proficiency in tools like Sparx Enterprise Architect, Microsoft SQL Server.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to manage stakeholders effectively.
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
Offer
We will offer a competitive salary and compensation package that includes a company car,
fuel card, hospitalization insurance, group insurance, net allowance, laptop and phone contract.
But more importantly you will have the opportunity to work in a company with a very open
culture: we work hard but we make sure we have a lot of fun along the way, we trust and
empower everyone to take decisions and we encourage everyone to grow and develop to
become the best version of themselves.
Benefits
Company Car
Meal Vouchers
Fuel Card
Company phone & subscription
Net Expenses
Group Insurance
Health Insurance
Parking
